sp-acj4-0-real

Given
\(x \in \mathbb{R}\)
Claim
\(\displaystyle \operatorname{arcosh}\left(\cosh x\right) = \left|x\right|\)
Expected
true equal at every admissible point

the two sides are equal at every admissible point

SimpliPy acj-4 (MIT) rules_real.json[0]: acosh cosh _0 -> abs _0

Lean proof: included

(case sp-acj4-0-real (category simplipy-f64-edge)
  (note "SimpliPy acj-4 (MIT) rules_real.json[0]: acosh cosh _0  ->  abs _0")
  (var x real)
  (ask (= (acosh (cosh x)) (abs x)))
  (expect true)
  (lean-proof "obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := AE.IsReal.exists hd0; refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩; rw [AE.cosh_ofReal, AE.acosh_ofReal (Real.one_le_cosh r), AE.abs_ofReal, ← Real.cosh_abs, Real.arcosh_cosh (abs_nonneg r)]"))

Claim

Expected
true equal at every admissible point

the two sides are equal at every admissible point

  (note "SimpliPy acj-4 (MIT) rules_real.json[115]: / log _0 (-4)  ->  log rootn _0 (-4)")
  (var x real)
